_comment: UI walkthrough route manifest for the audit harness. The RENDERED walkthrough (console errors, layout, real click-through) is executed by a browser agent (Claude in Chrome pointed at dashboard.legenex.com as an operator) or by Nick; findings land in AuditFinding with layer='ui', source='walkthrough'. This file is the ordered script: what to open and what each page should show. Auth pages, buyer/supplier portals, and raw API endpoints are excluded from the operator walkthrough.

operator_routes.expect: Overview: page title + muted description, cards, no flat gray defaults
Leads table inside a card, status badges, row hover
Filtered leads view renders, empty state in a card if none
StateStatus view (MVA computed, WC may be empty)
Distribution Dashboard. Distribution nav shows FIVE sections: Dashboard, Campaigns, Buyers, Webhooks, Conversion Events
Buyers list, and detail tabs Routing/Deliveries/Summary. REACHABLE from the distribution nav
RouteGroups view (0 configured pre-cutover, empty state in a card)
Route Simulator; opening real-config mode settles CAP-2
Campaigns list (0 pre-cutover, empty state in a card)
Webhooks (renamed): the live LeadByteConnector page, 4 enabled. READ-ONLY during audit
Conversion Events (3 enabled). READ-ONLY during audit
Payload tester renders (no live send during audit)
Settings shell; nav includes the new Audits section
Audits: Run audit button, run list, findings by verdict, layer labels

per_page_checks: No uncaught console errors on load
Page has a title treatment and muted description (not a bare h1 on canvas)
Content sits in cards (rounded-lg border bg-card), not flat rows on raw canvas
Empty states are centered muted text inside a card, not a bare sentence
No flat gray default tables (design-system regression signature)
Every sidebar and section link resolves to a real route (no dead links)
Primary and secondary buttons use semantic tokens
READ-ONLY: never toggle connector/Conversion Event enabled states, never post a live lead
